"""
fig1_overview.py — Hero figure for CoRL 2026.
Three-panel overview: (a) Training setup, (b) Factorial design, (c) Key result.
All data from v2 codebase (Table 1 in paper).
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# === Paper color palette (semantic, consistent across all figures) ===
COLORS = {
    'vanilla':     '#4C72B0',
    'full_occ_bn': '#C44E52',
    'full_occ_ln': '#E69F00',
    'random_occ':  '#55A868',
    'detach_bn':   '#8172B3',
    'detach_ln':   '#937860',
    'depth':       '#CCB974',
    'cutoff':      '#64B5CD',
}

UI = {
    'text':         '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':       '#95A5A6',
    'encoder_fill': '#EBF0F7',
    'encoder_edge': '#4C72B0',
    'llm_fill':     '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':     '#937860',
    'head_fill':    '#FFF3E0',
    'head_edge':    '#E69F00',
    'action_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'action_edge':  '#55A868',
    'grid':         '#DEE2E6',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Liberation Serif', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 14,
    'text.color': UI['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': UI['text'],
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'cm',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14.5, 5.5), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.015, 0.06, 0.30, 0.86])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.34, 0.06, 0.24, 0.86])
ax_c = fig.add_axes([0.635, 0.12, 0.345, 0.72])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')


def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=13, lw=1.8, radius=0.18):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.22, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight='bold', color=UI['text'], zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.28, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11,
                color=UI['subtle'], zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight='bold', color=UI['text'], zorder=4)


def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.6, style='->', mutation=13):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)


# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): Training Architecture
# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.1, 9.6, '(a) Training Setup', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold',
          va='top', color=UI['text'])

draw_box(ax_a, (3.2, 0.3), 3.6, 1.1, 'RGB Observation', fill='#F0F4F8',
         edge=UI['subtle'], fontsize=11.5)
draw_box(ax_a, (1.0, 2.4), 3.0, 1.0, 'DINOv2', sublabel='1024-d patches',
         fill=UI['encoder_fill'], edge=UI['encoder_edge'])
draw_box(ax_a, (5.5, 2.4), 3.0, 1.0, 'SigLIP', sublabel='1152-d patches',
         fill=UI['encoder_fill'], edge=UI['encoder_edge'])
draw_arrow(ax_a, (4.2, 1.4), (2.5, 2.4), color=UI['encoder_edge'])
draw_arrow(ax_a, (5.8, 1.4), (7.0, 2.4), color=UI['encoder_edge'])

draw_box(ax_a, (2.5, 4.2), 5.0, 1.0, 'LLM Backbone', sublabel='Llama-2 7B + LoRA',
         fill=UI['llm_fill'], edge=UI['llm_edge'])
draw_arrow(ax_a, (2.5, 3.4), (4.0, 4.2), color='#666')
draw_arrow(ax_a, (7.0, 3.4), (6.0, 4.2), color='#666')

ax_a.annotate('', xy=(7.2, 3.5), xytext=(7.5, 5.95),

draw_arrow(ax_a, (7.5, 8.1), (7.5, 7.0), color=UI['subtle'],

# ============================================================
# PANEL (b): 2x2 Factorial Design

ax_b.text(0.1, 9.6, '(b) Factorial Design', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold',

mx, my = 1.5, 4.0
mw, mh = 7.0, 4.4

ax_b.text(mx + mw/2, my - 2.55,

# ============================================================

# CORRECTED v2 data (Table 1), grouped by normalization type
cdata = [

vanilla_car = 0.745

ax_c.set_xlim(0.655, 0.87)

ax_c.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
ax_c.set_xlabel('Collision Avoidance Rate (CAR)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', labelpad=6)

ax_c.set_title('(c) Only BN + gradient flow falls below Vanilla',

# Group background bands
ax_c.axhspan(-0.5, 1.5, alpha=0.02, color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], zorder=0)
ax_c.axhspan(1.5, 3.5, alpha=0.02, color=COLORS['full_occ_ln'], zorder=0)
ax_c.text(0.865, 0.5, 'BN', fontsize=11, color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], ha='center', va='center',
          fontweight='bold', alpha=0.35,
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none', alpha=0.6))
ax_c.text(0.865, 2.5, 'LN', fontsize=11, color=COLORS['full_occ_ln'], ha='center', va='center',
          fontweight='bold', alpha=0.35,
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none', alpha=0.6))

# Vanilla reference
ax_c.axvline(x=vanilla_car, color=COLORS['vanilla'], linestyle='--',
             linewidth=1.8, alpha=0.7, zorder=1)
ax_c.text(vanilla_car + 0.003, -0.55, f'Vanilla  {vanilla_car:.3f}',
          fontsize=11.5, color=COLORS['vanilla'], va='top', ha='left',
          fontweight='bold',
          path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=3, foreground='white')])

# Below-baseline shading
ax_c.axvspan(0.655, vanilla_car, alpha=0.04, color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], zorder=0)

# Connecting lines: BN pair (y=0 Full OCC → y=1 Detach OCC) — adjacent!
ax_c.plot([0.725, 0.767], [0, 1], color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'],
          lw=1.3, linestyle=':', alpha=0.5, zorder=1)
ax_c.text(0.730, 0.55, '$-$4.2 pp', fontsize=11,
          color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], ha='left', va='center',
          fontweight='bold', alpha=0.8,
          path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=3, foreground='white')])

# LN pair (y=2 Full OCC+LN → y=3 Detach+LN) — adjacent!
ax_c.plot([0.773, 0.802], [2, 3], color=COLORS['full_occ_ln'],
          lw=1.3, linestyle=':', alpha=0.5, zorder=1)
ax_c.text(0.778, 2.55, '$-$2.9 pp', fontsize=11,
          color=COLORS['full_occ_ln'], ha='left', va='center',
          fontweight='bold', alpha=0.8,
          path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=3, foreground='white')])

# Plot data
for i, d in enumerate(cdata):
    ax_c.plot(d['car'], i, 'o', color=d['color'], markersize=11,

    if d['sd'] is not None:

    right_x = d['car'] + (d['sd'] if d['sd'] else 0) + 0.006
    label_text = f'{d["car"]:.3f} ± {d["sd"]:.3f}' if d['sd'] else f'{d["car"]:.3f}'

    ax_c.text(right_x, i + 0.02, label_text, fontsize=11, ha='left',

              path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=3, foreground='white')])

ax_c.set_yticks(list(range(len(cdata))))
ax_c.set_yticklabels([d['name'] for d in cdata], fontsize=10.5, linespacing=1.1)
ax_c.tick_params(axis='y', length=0, pad=6)
ax_c.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=12)
ax_c.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.10, color='#999', zorder=0)
ax_c.set_xticks([0.68, 0.70, 0.72, 0.74, 0.76, 0.78, 0.80, 0.82, 0.84, 0.86])

# Save
out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513/projects/occsafe_vla/docs/paper/figures'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig1_overview.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight',

1	---
2	description: 用 PaperBanana 生成高品质学术概念图（架构/流程/framework）。统计图不要用 PaperBanana，用 draw-paper-figure。需要 GOOGLE_API_KEY。
3	name: paper-banana
4	scope: global
5	tags:
6	  - visualization
7	  - paper
8	  - matplotlib
9	  - llm-codegen
10	  - conceptual-diagram
11	version: 4
12	tools:
13	  - request_secret
14	  - poll_secret_request
15	---
16	
17	# Paper Banana — 高品质学术概念图生成
18	
19	PaperBanana 由 Gemini Pro 自动写 matplotlib 代码，VLM Critic 评估渲染结果并迭代优化，输出顶会级别 300 DPI 概念图。
20	
21	**质量底线：每张图必须达到顶会论文的美观度——高级感、专业感、精致感。绝不接受 matplotlib 默认样式的廉价感。**
22	
23	## 适用范围
24	
25	| 场景 | 用什么 |
26	|------|--------|
27	| **概念图**（架构图、流程图、framework 示意） | **PaperBanana** ← 本 skill |
28	| **统计图**（scatter、bar、line、heatmap、forest） | **draw-paper-figure.skill.md**。**不要用 PaperBanana 画统计图** |
29	| 离线 / 无 GOOGLE_API_KEY | **draw-paper-figure.skill.md** |
30	
31	## 执行环境
32	
33	**PaperBanana 在本机（EC2）运行，不要 SSH 到远程服务器。**
34	
35	EC2（ap-northeast-1 东京）可直接访问 Gemini API，无需代理。
36	
37	## 前置条件
38	
39	### Step 1：获取 GOOGLE_API_KEY
40	
41	```python
42	request_secret(key_id="google_api_key", project="<project_name>", purpose="PaperBanana 概念图生成")
43	# 等待 Director 审批后
44	poll_secret_request(request_id="<返回的 request_id>", project="<project_name>")
45	```
46	
47	如果密钥尚未存储，告知 Director 需要 GOOGLE_API_KEY。
48	
49	### Step 2：安装验证（每次使用前必须检查）
50	
51	```bash
52	# 检查是否已安装
53	paperbanana --version 2>/dev/null || {
54	  echo "PaperBanana 未安装，正在安装..."
55	  pip install paperbanana -q
56	  paperbanana --version
57	}
58	```
59	
60	如果 `paperbanana --version` 失败（命令不存在），必须先 `pip install paperbanana -q` 安装。版本需 ≥ 0.1.2。
61	
62	**设计前必读** `skills/global/paper-visualization.skill.md` 的概念图 L1（防丑 7 条）+ L2（叙事 6 条）+ L3 Pattern + Checklist。统计图部分不适用于 PaperBanana。
63	
64	## 命令：generate
65	
66	概念图用 `generate` 子命令。**必须显式指定 `--vlm-model gemini-2.5-pro`**（默认模型 `gemini-2.0-flash` 已废弃，不指定会崩溃）。**`--iterations 5`**。
67	
68	## 完整流程
69	
70	### Step 1：写意图描述文件
71	
72	将详细设计描述写入文件（太长不适合命令行参数）：
73	
74	```bash
75	cat > /tmp/fig_intent.txt << 'INTENT'
76	Three-panel academic figure for a top-venue paper (full width, aspect ratio ~3.2:1, figsize 14x4.5 inches):
77	
78	Panel (a) 'The Phenomenon' (left, ~38% width):
79	Grouped bar chart. TF bars: dark navy (#2C3E50). AR bars: academic red (#C0392B).
80	Exact data: Base TF=0.501 AR=0.019, ThreadGate TF=0.504 AR=0.064, ...
81	Y-axis 'Mid-turn GAR' range 0–0.55. Only left+bottom spines. Serif font 10pt.
82	Add bracket annotation '8-17x gap' between bar groups.
83	
84	Panel (b) 'Diagnostic Chain' (center, ~24% width):
85	Vertical flowchart, 4 rounded boxes connected by thin gray arrows:
86	  Step 1: light gray (#F5F6F7) box, thin border (#DEE2E6), 'Gate Analysis' + subtitle. Green ✓
87	  Step 2: same style, 'PCGrad Exclusion'. Red ✗
88	  Step 3: same style, 'Representation Check'. Red ✗
89	  Step 4: light green (#D4EDDA) background, 'Conclusion: Exposure bias'. Green ✓
90	No axes, no spines. Clean infographic style.
91	
92	Panel (c) 'Constructive Evidence' (right, ~38% width):
93	Line plot. Data points: (0, 0.064), (3, 0.556), (5, 0.727).
94	Navy line (#2C3E50), open circles (white fill, navy edge, width 2).
95	Light blue fill (#EBF5FB, alpha 0.4) under curve.
96	Annotate '11x recovery' in muted gray, 9pt italic.
97	
98	OVERALL STYLE:
99	- 300 DPI, white background, publication quality
100	- Serif font (Times New Roman or similar) throughout
101	- Panel labels '(a)', '(b)', '(c)' in 11pt bold at top-left
102	- Generous white space (wspace=0.35)
103	- Muted academic palette: navy #2C3E50, red #C0392B, green #27AE60, gray #7F8C8D
104	- NO matplotlib default styling: no gray background, no thick gridlines, no tab10 colors
105	- Drop shadows on boxes: subtle, 2px offset, 10% opacity
106	- Rounded corners 8px on all rectangles
107	- Arrow heads: small, elegant, not bulky
108	INTENT
109	```
110	
111	### Step 2：运行 generate
112	
113	```bash
114	GOOGLE_API_KEY="[REDACTED]" paperbanana generate \
115	  --input /tmp/fig_intent.txt \
116	  --caption "Three-panel diagnostic framework: (a) TF vs AR performance gap, (b) systematic diagnosis chain, (c) beta-steering recovery evidence" \
117	  --vlm-model gemini-2.5-pro \
118	  --output figures/paper/fig1_overview.png \
119	  --iterations 5
120	```
121	
122	### Step 3：视觉检查（不可跳过）
123	
124	**Read 生成的 PNG 文件**，视觉评估以下维度：
125	
126	1. **高级感**：是否有顶会论文的精致感？还是看起来像课程作业？
127	2. **颜色**：是否有语义（不是随机分配）？是否和谐、不刺眼？
128	3. **文字**：缩到 column width 后是否 ≥ 7pt 可读？
129	4. **布局**：留白是否合理？元素是否对齐？
130	5. **细节**：圆角、阴影、箭头是否精致？边框是否统一？
131	
132	**不满意 → 必须修改意图描述文件，重新生成。**
133	
134	### Step 4：转 PDF
135	
136	```bash
137	python3 -c "
138	import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
139	import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.image as mpimg
140	img = mpimg.imread('figures/paper/fig1_overview.png')
141	h, w = img.shape[:2]
142	fig = plt.figure(figsize=(w/300, h/300), dpi=300)
143	ax = fig.add_axes([0,0,1,1]); ax.imshow(img); ax.axis('off')
144	plt.savefig('figures/paper/fig1_overview.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0)
145	plt.close()
146	"
147	```
148	
149	## 意图描述质量红线
150	
151	Intent 质量直接决定图的质量。必须包含以下 7 项（缺一不可）：
152	
153	1. **空间布局**：每个 panel 的宽度占比（如 38%/24%/38%）
154	2. **组件形状 + 尺寸**：圆角半径 8px、figsize (14, 4.5)
155	3. **颜色 hex 码**：不说"蓝色"，说 "#2C3E50"，绑定语义
156	4. **所有文字内容**：box label、副标题、箭头 annotation
157	5. **尺寸规格**：DPI 300、字号 10-12pt body / 8-9pt labels
158	6. **细节规格**：阴影偏移 2px / 10% opacity、箭头粗细、边框宽度
159	7. **反面约束**："NO matplotlib default styling, NO gray background, NO tab10 colors"
160	
161	### 美学风格关键词（必须在 intent 中出现）
162	
163	```
164	STYLE REQUIREMENTS:
165	- Publication quality for a TOP venue (NeurIPS/ICML/EMNLP)
166	- Elegant, premium, sophisticated — NOT cheap or homework-like
167	- Subtle drop shadows (2px, 10% opacity) on boxes
168	- Rounded corners (8px) on all rectangles
169	- Thin, elegant arrow heads — not bulky matplotlib defaults
170	- Serif font (Times) for labels, sans-serif (Helvetica) for annotations
171	- Muted, harmonious color palette — NO saturated primary colors
172	- Generous white space between elements
173	- Consistent visual weight across all panels
174	```
175	
176	### 反面教材（这样的 intent 一定画不好）
177	
178	- "Draw a pipeline diagram with three stages"
179	- "Architecture diagram for our system"
180	
181	太模糊。LLM 会用 matplotlib 默认样式填充所有你没指定的细节，结果就是廉价感。
182	
183	## 迭代策略（至少 3 轮外部迭代，Hero Figure 至少 5 轮）
184	
185	PaperBanana 内部有 VLM Critic 迭代（`--iterations 5`），但这还不够。你必须做**外部迭代**：
186	
187	### 第 1 轮：基础生成
188	运行 PaperBanana → Read PNG → 识别大方向问题（布局、配色、结构）
189	
190	### 第 2 轮：结构修复
191	修改意图描述（布局占比、颜色 hex、组件关系）→ 重新运行 → Read PNG
192	
193	### 第 3 轮：细节打磨
194	修改意图描述（字号、阴影、对齐、箭头粗细）→ 重新运行 → Read PNG
195	
196	### 第 4 轮（Hero Figure）：风格统一
197	线宽 / 字号 / 间距全图统一？与论文其他图配色一致？→ 重新运行 → Read PNG
198	
199	### 第 5 轮（Hero Figure）：最终 polish
200	像素级检查 → 缩到 column width 后文字 ≥ 7pt？→ 终极判断：放在 NeurIPS best paper 里违和吗？
201	
202	### 判断标准
203	
204	**可以交付**：看起来像 NeurIPS 2025 best paper 里的图。
205	**不可交付**：看起来像 matplotlib gallery 的示例图。
206	
207	## 失败回退
208	
209	如果 PaperBanana 多次崩溃（API 错误、模型不兼容）：
210	
211	1. 确认 `--vlm-model gemini-2.5-pro` 是否指定
212	2. 确认 GOOGLE_API_KEY 是否有效：`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?key=$GOOGLE_API_KEY"` 应返回 200

---
description: 用 PaperBanana 生成高品质学术概念图（架构/流程/framework）。统计图不要用 PaperBanana，用 draw-paper-figure。需要 GOOGLE_API_KEY。
name: paper-banana
scope: global
tags:
  - visualization
  - paper

  - conceptual-diagram

---

# Paper Banana — 高品质学术概念图生成

PaperBanana 由 Gemini Pro 自动写 matplotlib 代码，VLM Critic 评估渲染结果并迭代优化，输出顶会级别 300 DPI 概念图。

**质量底线：每张图必须达到顶会论文的美观度——高级感、专业感、精致感。绝不接受 matplotlib 默认样式的廉价感。**

## 适用范围

| 场景 | 用什么 |
|------|--------|
| **概念图**（架构图、流程图、framework 示意） | **PaperBanana** ← 本 skill |
| **统计图**（scatter、bar、line、heatmap、forest） | **draw-paper-figure.skill.md**。**不要用 PaperBanana 画统计图** |
| 离线 / 无 GOOGLE_API_KEY | **draw-paper-figure.skill.md** |

## 执行环境

**PaperBanana 在本机（EC2）运行，不要 SSH 到远程服务器。**

EC2（ap-northeast-1 东京）可直接访问 Gemini API，无需代理。

## 前置条件

### Step 1：获取 GOOGLE_API_KEY

```python
request_secret(key_id="google_api_key", project="<project_name>", purpose="PaperBanana 概念图生成")
# 等待 Director 审批后
poll_secret_request(request_id="<返回的 request_id>", project="<project_name>")
```

如果密钥尚未存储，告知 Director 需要 GOOGLE_API_KEY。

### Step 2：安装验证（每次使用前必须检查）

```bash
# 检查是否已安装
paperbanana --version 2>/dev/null || {
  echo "PaperBanana 未安装，正在安装..."
  pip install paperbanana -q
  paperbanana --version
}
```

如果 `paperbanana --version` 失败（命令不存在），必须先 `pip install paperbanana -q` 安装。版本需 ≥ 0.1.2。

**设计前必读** `skills/global/paper-visualization.skill.md` 的概念图 L1（防丑 7 条）+ L2（叙事 6 条）+ L3 Pattern + Checklist。统计图部分不适用于 PaperBanana。

## 命令：generate

概念图用 `generate` 子命令。**必须显式指定 `--vlm-model gemini-2.5-pro`**（默认模型 `gemini-2.0-flash` 已废弃，不指定会崩溃）。**`--iterations 5`**。

## 完整流程

### Step 1：写意图描述文件

将详细设计描述写入文件（太长不适合命令行参数）：

```bash
cat > /tmp/fig_intent.txt << 'INTENT'
Three-panel academic figure for a top-venue paper (full width, aspect ratio ~3.2:1, figsize 14x4.5 inches):

Panel (a) 'The Phenomenon' (left, ~38% width):
Grouped bar chart. TF bars: dark navy (#2C3E50). AR bars: academic red (#C0392B).
Exact data: Base TF=0.501 AR=0.019, ThreadGate TF=0.504 AR=0.064, ...
Y-axis 'Mid-turn GAR' range 0–0.55. Only left+bottom spines. Serif font 10pt.
Add bracket annotation '8-17x gap' between bar groups.

Panel (b) 'Diagnostic Chain' (center, ~24% width):
Vertical flowchart, 4 rounded boxes connected by thin gray arrows:
  Step 1: light gray (#F5F6F7) box, thin border (#DEE2E6), 'Gate Analysis' + subtitle. Green ✓
  Step 2: same style, 'PCGrad Exclusion'. Red ✗
  Step 3: same style, 'Representation Check'. Red ✗
  Step 4: light green (#D4EDDA) background, 'Conclusion: Exposure bias'. Green ✓
No axes, no spines. Clean infographic style.

Panel (c) 'Constructive Evidence' (right, ~38% width):
Line plot. Data points: (0, 0.064), (3, 0.556), (5, 0.727).
Navy line (#2C3E50), open circles (white fill, navy edge, width 2).
Light blue fill (#EBF5FB, alpha 0.4) under curve.
Annotate '11x recovery' in muted gray, 9pt italic.

OVERALL STYLE:
- 300 DPI, white background, publication quality
- Serif font (Times New Roman or similar) throughout
- Panel labels '(a)', '(b)', '(c)' in 11pt bold at top-left
- Generous white space (wspace=0.35)
- Muted academic palette: navy #2C3E50, red #C0392B, green #27AE60, gray #7F8C8D
- NO matplotlib default styling: no gray background, no thick gridlines, no tab10 colors
- Drop shadows on boxes: subtle, 2px offset, 10% opacity
- Rounded corners 8px on all rectangles
- Arrow heads: small, elegant, not bulky
INTENT
```

### Step 2：运行 generate

```bash
GOOGLE_API_KEY="[REDACTED]" paperbanana generate \
  --input /tmp/fig_intent.txt \
  --caption "Three-panel diagnostic framework: (a) TF vs AR performance gap, (b) systematic diagnosis chain, (c) beta-steering recovery evidence" \
  --vlm-model gemini-2.5-pro \
  --output figures/paper/fig1_overview.png \
  --iterations 5
```

### Step 3：视觉检查（不可跳过）

**Read 生成的 PNG 文件**，视觉评估以下维度：

1. **高级感**：是否有顶会论文的精致感？还是看起来像课程作业？
2. **颜色**：是否有语义（不是随机分配）？是否和谐、不刺眼？
3. **文字**：缩到 column width 后是否 ≥ 7pt 可读？
4. **布局**：留白是否合理？元素是否对齐？
5. **细节**：圆角、阴影、箭头是否精致？边框是否统一？

**不满意 → 必须修改意图描述文件，重新生成。**

### Step 4：转 PDF

```bash
python3 -c "
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.image as mpimg
img = mpimg.imread('figures/paper/fig1_overview.png')
h, w = img.shape[:2]
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(w/300, h/300), dpi=300)
ax = fig.add_axes([0,0,1,1]); ax.imshow(img); ax.axis('off')
plt.savefig('figures/paper/fig1_overview.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0)
plt.close()
"
```

## 意图描述质量红线

Intent 质量直接决定图的质量。必须包含以下 7 项（缺一不可）：

1. **空间布局**：每个 panel 的宽度占比（如 38%/24%/38%）
2. **组件形状 + 尺寸**：圆角半径 8px、figsize (14, 4.5)
3. **颜色 hex 码**：不说"蓝色"，说 "#2C3E50"，绑定语义
4. **所有文字内容**：box label、副标题、箭头 annotation
5. **尺寸规格**：DPI 300、字号 10-12pt body / 8-9pt labels
6. **细节规格**：阴影偏移 2px / 10% opacity、箭头粗细、边框宽度
7. **反面约束**："NO matplotlib default styling, NO gray background, NO tab10 colors"

### 美学风格关键词（必须在 intent 中出现）

```
STYLE REQUIREMENTS:
- Publication quality for a TOP venue (NeurIPS/ICML/EMNLP)
- Elegant, premium, sophisticated — NOT cheap or homework-like
- Subtle drop shadows (2px, 10% opacity) on boxes
- Rounded corners (8px) on all rectangles
- Thin, elegant arrow heads — not bulky matplotlib defaults
- Serif font (Times) for labels, sans-serif (Helvetica) for annotations
- Muted, harmonious color palette — NO saturated primary colors
- Generous white space between elements
- Consistent visual weight across all panels
```

### 反面教材（这样的 intent 一定画不好）

- "Draw a pipeline diagram with three stages"
- "Architecture diagram for our system"

太模糊。LLM 会用 matplotlib 默认样式填充所有你没指定的细节，结果就是廉价感。

## 迭代策略（至少 3 轮外部迭代，Hero Figure 至少 5 轮）

PaperBanana 内部有 VLM Critic 迭代（`--iterations 5`），但这还不够。你必须做**外部迭代**：

### 第 1 轮：基础生成
运行 PaperBanana → Read PNG → 识别大方向问题（布局、配色、结构）

### 第 2 轮：结构修复
修改意图描述（布局占比、颜色 hex、组件关系）→ 重新运行 → Read PNG

### 第 3 轮：细节打磨
修改意图描述（字号、阴影、对齐、箭头粗细）→ 重新运行 → Read PNG

### 第 4 轮（Hero Figure）：风格统一
线宽 / 字号 / 间距全图统一？与论文其他图配色一致？→ 重新运行 → Read PNG

### 第 5 轮（Hero Figure）：最终 polish
像素级检查 → 缩到 column width 后文字 ≥ 7pt？→ 终极判断：放在 NeurIPS best paper 里违和吗？

### 判断标准

**可以交付**：看起来像 NeurIPS 2025 best paper 里的图。
**不可交付**：看起来像 matplotlib gallery 的示例图。

## 失败回退

如果 PaperBanana 多次崩溃（API 错误、模型不兼容）：

1. 确认 `--vlm-model gemini-2.5-pro` 是否指定
2. 确认 GOOGLE_API_KEY 是否有效：`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?key=$GOOGLE_API_KEY"` 应返回 200
3. 如果仍然失败，回退 matplotlib 手写：
   - Read `skills/global/paper-visualization.skill.md` 获取 L1-L4 设计标准
   - 写 Python 脚本手动画概念图（FancyBboxPatch、FancyArrowPatch 等）
   - **同样必须 Read PNG 做视觉检查，至少迭代 3 轮**
   - **同样必须达到顶会级别的美观度**
   - 保存 .py 脚本到 figures/paper/ 目录便于后续修改

"""

Two-panel overview: (a) Training setup, (b) Factorial design.
Fallback matplotlib version (PaperBanana API unavailable).
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, BoxStyle
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

COLORS = {
    'vanilla':     '#4C72B0',
    'full_occ_bn': '#C44E52',
    'full_occ_ln': '#E69F00',
    'random_occ':  '#55A868',
    'detach_bn':   '#8172B3',
    'detach_ln':   '#937860',
    'depth':       '#CCB974',
    'cutoff':      '#64B5CD',
}

UI = {
    'text':         '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':       '#95A5A6',
    'encoder_fill': '#EBF0F7',
    'encoder_edge': '#4C72B0',
    'llm_fill':     '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':     '#937860',
    'head_fill':    '#FFF3E0',
    'head_edge':    '#E69F00',
    'action_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'action_edge':  '#55A868',
    'grid':         '#DEE2E6',
    'bg_light':     '#F8F9FA',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Liberation Serif', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 14,
    'text.color': UI['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': UI['text'],
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'cm',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5.5), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.015, 0.04, 0.48, 0.90])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.54, 0.04, 0.44, 0.90])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')


def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=13, subfontsize=11, lw=1.6, radius=0.20, shadow=True,
             label_color=None):
    if shadow:
        shadow_box = FancyBboxPatch(
            (xy[0] + 0.04, xy[1] - 0.04), w, h,
            boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
            facecolor='#00000008', edgecolor='none', linewidth=0, zorder=2)
        ax.add_patch(shadow_box)
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    tc = label_color if label_color else UI['text']
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.22, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight='bold', color=tc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.26, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=subfontsize,
                color=UI['subtle'], zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight='bold', color=tc, zorder=4)


def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.4, style='->', mutation=12):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=2,
                            shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)


# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): Training Architecture
# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.15, 9.55, '(a)', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])
ax_a.text(0.65, 9.55, 'Training Setup', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])

# RGB Observation
draw_box(ax_a, (3.2, 0.3), 3.6, 1.0, 'RGB Observation', fill='#F0F4F8',
         edge=UI['subtle'], fontsize=11.5, lw=1.2)

# Encoders
draw_box(ax_a, (1.0, 2.3), 3.0, 1.0, 'DINOv2', sublabel='1024-d patches',
         fill=UI['encoder_fill'], edge=UI['encoder_edge'])
draw_box(ax_a, (5.5, 2.3), 3.0, 1.0, 'SigLIP', sublabel='1152-d patches',
         fill=UI['encoder_fill'], edge=UI['encoder_edge'])

# Arrows from RGB to encoders
draw_arrow(ax_a, (4.2, 1.3), (2.5, 2.3), color=UI['encoder_edge'], lw=1.3)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (5.8, 1.3), (7.0, 2.3), color=UI['encoder_edge'], lw=1.3)

# LLM Backbone
draw_box(ax_a, (2.3, 4.1), 5.4, 1.0, 'LLM Backbone', sublabel='Llama-2 7B + LoRA',
         fill=UI['llm_fill'], edge=UI['llm_edge'])

# Arrows from encoders to LLM
draw_arrow(ax_a, (2.5, 3.3), (3.8, 4.1), color='#777', lw=1.3)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (7.0, 3.3), (6.2, 4.1), color='#777', lw=1.3)

# Concat annotation
ax_a.text(5.0, 3.7, 'concat (2176-d)', fontsize=10.5, ha='center',
          color=UI['subtle'], style='italic')

# Action Head
draw_box(ax_a, (1.2, 5.9), 3.2, 1.0, 'Action Head', sublabel='7-DoF tokens',
         fill=UI['action_fill'], edge=UI['action_edge'])
draw_arrow(ax_a, (3.5, 5.1), (2.8, 5.9), color=UI['action_edge'], lw=1.6)

# L_action label
ax_a.text(1.3, 7.25, r'$\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{action}}$', fontsize=14,
          ha='center', color=UI['action_edge'], fontweight='bold')
draw_arrow(ax_a, (1.9, 7.15), (2.2, 6.9), color=UI['action_edge'], lw=1.0)

# Aux Head
draw_box(ax_a, (5.8, 5.9), 3.2, 1.0, 'Aux Head', sublabel='BEV / Depth',
         fill=UI['head_fill'], edge=UI['head_edge'])
draw_arrow(ax_a, (6.5, 5.1), (7.4, 5.9), color=UI['head_edge'], lw=1.6)

# lambda * L_aux label
ax_a.text(8.8, 7.25, r'$\lambda(t) \cdot \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{aux}}$',
          fontsize=14, ha='center', color=UI['head_edge'], fontweight='bold')
draw_arrow(ax_a, (8.3, 7.15), (8.0, 6.9), color=UI['head_edge'], lw=1.0)

# BN/LN badge
ax_a.text(9.3, 6.05, 'BN/LN', fontsize=10, ha='center',
          color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], fontweight='bold',
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white',
                    edgecolor=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], lw=1.2))

# Gradient flow dashed arrow (key element)
ax_a.annotate('', xy=(7.0, 3.5), xytext=(7.3, 5.85),
              arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'],
                              lw=2.0, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)),
                              connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.15'))

# "gradient flow?" annotation box
ax_a.text(8.9, 4.45, 'gradient\nflow?', fontsize=11.5, ha='center',
          color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], fontweight='bold', style='italic',
          linespacing=1.2,
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#FFF0F0',
                    edgecolor=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], lw=1.0, alpha=0.9))

# "discarded at inference" annotation
ax_a.text(7.4, 8.3, 'discarded at inference', fontsize=10.5,
          ha='center', color='#7F8C8D', style='italic',
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#FFF8E1',
                    edgecolor='#BDC3C7', lw=0.8, alpha=0.9))
draw_arrow(ax_a, (7.4, 8.0), (7.4, 6.9), color=UI['subtle'], lw=0.7)


# ============================================================
# PANEL (b): 2x2 Factorial Design
# ============================================================
ax_b.text(0.15, 9.55, '(b)', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])
ax_b.text(0.65, 9.55, 'Factorial Design', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])

mx, my = 1.5, 3.8
mw, mh = 7.0, 4.6
cell_w, cell_h = mw / 2, mh / 2

# Column headers
ax_b.text(mx + cell_w * 0.5, my + mh + 0.55, 'Gradient ON',
          ha='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'])
ax_b.text(mx + cell_w * 1.5, my + mh + 0.55, 'Gradient OFF',
          ha='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['detach_bn'])

# Row headers
ax_b.text(mx - 0.25, my + cell_h * 1.5, 'BN',
          ha='right', va='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=UI['text'])
ax_b.text(mx - 0.25, my + cell_h * 0.5, 'LN',
          ha='right', va='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=UI['text'])

cells_b = [
    (0, 1, 'Full OCC',      'full_occ_bn', '#FDECEA'),
    (1, 1, 'Detach OCC',    'detach_bn',   '#EEEBF5'),
    (0, 0, 'Full OCC+LN',   'full_occ_ln', '#FFF5E0'),
    (1, 0, 'Detach+LN',     'detach_ln',   '#F3EDE6'),
]

# Outer border with shadow
shadow_border = FancyBboxPatch(
    (mx + 0.04, my - 0.04), mw, mh,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.2",
    facecolor='#00000006', edgecolor='none', linewidth=0, zorder=1)
ax_b.add_patch(shadow_border)

border = FancyBboxPatch((mx, my), mw, mh, boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.2",
                         facecolor='white', edgecolor='#BDC3C7', linewidth=1.0, zorder=2)
ax_b.add_patch(border)

# Grid lines
ax_b.plot([mx, mx + mw], [my + cell_h, my + cell_h],
          color=UI['grid'], lw=0.8, zorder=2.5)
ax_b.plot([mx + cell_w, mx + cell_w], [my, my + mh],
          color=UI['grid'], lw=0.8, zorder=2.5)

for col, row, name, ckey, bg in cells_b:
    x = mx + col * cell_w
    y = my + row * cell_h
    pad = 0.12
    inner = FancyBboxPatch((x + pad, y + pad), cell_w - 2*pad, cell_h - 2*pad,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
                           facecolor=bg, edgecolor=COLORS[ckey],
                           linewidth=1.2, zorder=3)
    ax_b.add_patch(inner)
    ax_b.text(x + cell_w/2, y + cell_h/2, name,
              ha='center', va='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
              color=COLORS[ckey], zorder=4)

# Additional conditions
ax_b.text(mx, my - 0.55, 'Additional:', fontsize=11.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=UI['text'])
extras = [
    ('Random OCC',      COLORS['random_occ']),
    ('Depth-only',      COLORS['depth']),
    ('Cutoff / Reverse', COLORS['cutoff']),
    ('Vanilla (no aux)', COLORS['vanilla']),
]
for i, (name, color) in enumerate(extras):
    cx = mx if i < 2 else mx + 3.8
    cy = my - 1.05 - (i % 2) * 0.50
    ax_b.plot(cx + 0.1, cy, 's', color=color, markersize=5, zorder=4)
    ax_b.text(cx + 0.4, cy, name, fontsize=10.5, va='center', color=UI['text'])

# Factor summary
ax_b.text(mx + mw/2, my - 2.7,
          '5 factors across 12 conditions:\ngradient flow / label content / normalization\n'
          'reference frame / temporal extent',
          ha='center', fontsize=10, color=UI['subtle'], style='italic',
          linespacing=1.3)

# Save
out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513/projects/occsafe_vla/docs/paper/figures'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig1_architecture_pb.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight',
            pad_inches=0.05, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
print("Saved fig1_architecture_pb.png")

"""
fig1_architecture_pb.py — Hero figure panels (a) + (b) for CoRL 2026.
Two-panel overview: (a) Training setup, (b) Factorial design.
Fallback matplotlib version (PaperBanana API unavailable).
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, BoxStyle
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

COLORS = {
    'vanilla':     '#4C72B0',
    'full_occ_bn': '#C44E52',
    'full_occ_ln': '#E69F00',
    'random_occ':  '#55A868',
    'detach_bn':   '#8172B3',
    'detach_ln':   '#937860',
    'depth':       '#CCB974',
    'cutoff':      '#64B5CD',
}

UI = {
    'text':         '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':       '#95A5A6',
    'encoder_fill': '#EBF0F7',
    'encoder_edge': '#4C72B0',
    'llm_fill':     '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':     '#937860',
    'head_fill':    '#FFF3E0',
    'head_edge':    '#E69F00',
    'action_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'action_edge':  '#55A868',
    'grid':         '#DEE2E6',
    'bg_light':     '#F8F9FA',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Liberation Serif', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 14,
    'text.color': UI['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': UI['text'],
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'cm',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5.5), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.04, 0.50, 0.90])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.535, 0.04, 0.45, 0.90])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')


def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=13, subfontsize=11, lw=1.6, radius=0.20, shadow=True,
             label_color=None):
    if shadow:
        shadow_box = FancyBboxPatch(
            (xy[0] + 0.04, xy[1] - 0.04), w, h,
            boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
            facecolor='#00000008', edgecolor='none', linewidth=0, zorder=2)
        ax.add_patch(shadow_box)
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    tc = label_color if label_color else UI['text']
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.22, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight='bold', color=tc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.26, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=subfontsize,
                color=UI['subtle'], zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight='bold', color=tc, zorder=4)


def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.4, style='->', mutation=12):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=2,
                            shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)


# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): Training Architecture
# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.15, 9.55, '(a)', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])
ax_a.text(0.65, 9.55, 'Training Setup', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])

# RGB Observation
draw_box(ax_a, (3.2, 0.3), 3.6, 1.0, 'RGB Observation', fill='#F0F4F8',

"""
fig1_architecture_pb.py — Hero figure panels (a) + (b) for CoRL 2026.
Two-panel overview: (a) Training setup, (b) Factorial design.
Fallback matplotlib version (PaperBanana API unavailable).
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, BoxStyle
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

COLORS = {
    'vanilla':     '#4C72B0',
    'full_occ_bn': '#C44E52',
    'full_occ_ln': '#E69F00',
    'random_occ':  '#55A868',
    'detach_bn':   '#8172B3',
    'detach_ln':   '#937860',
    'depth':       '#CCB974',
    'cutoff':      '#64B5CD',
}

UI = {
    'text':         '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':       '#95A5A6',
    'encoder_fill': '#EBF0F7',
    'encoder_edge': '#4C72B0',
    'llm_fill':     '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':     '#937860',
    'head_fill':    '#FFF3E0',
    'head_edge':    '#E69F00',
    'action_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'action_edge':  '#55A868',
    'grid':         '#DEE2E6',
    'bg_light':     '#F8F9FA',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Liberation Serif', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 14,
    'text.color': UI['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': UI['text'],
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'cm',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5.5), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.04, 0.50, 0.90])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.535, 0.04, 0.45, 0.90])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')


def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=13, subfontsize=11, lw=1.6, radius=0.20, shadow=True,
             label_color=None):
    if shadow:
        shadow_box = FancyBboxPatch(
            (xy[0] + 0.04, xy[1] - 0.04), w, h,
            boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
            facecolor='#00000008', edgecolor='none', linewidth=0, zorder=2)
        ax.add_patch(shadow_box)
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    tc = label_color if label_color else UI['text']
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.22, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight='bold', color=tc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.26, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=subfontsize,
                color=UI['subtle'], zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight='bold', color=tc, zorder=4)


def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.4, style='->', mutation=12):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=2,
                            shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)


# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): Training Architecture
# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.15, 9.55, '(a)', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])
ax_a.text(0.65, 9.55, 'Training Setup', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])

# --- Architecture centered around x=5 ---
# RGB Observation (centered)
draw_box(ax_a, (3.0, 0.3), 3.6, 1.0, 'RGB Observation', fill='#F0F4F8',
         edge=UI['subtle'], fontsize=11.5, lw=1.2)

# Encoders (symmetric about center)
draw_box(ax_a, (0.8, 2.3), 3.2, 1.05, 'DINOv2', sublabel='1024-d patches',
         fill=UI['encoder_fill'], edge=UI['encoder_edge'], subfontsize=11)
draw_box(ax_a, (5.6, 2.3), 3.2, 1.05, 'SigLIP', sublabel='1152-d patches',
         fill=UI['encoder_fill'], edge=UI['encoder_edge'], subfontsize=11)

# Arrows from RGB to encoders
draw_arrow(ax_a, (4.0, 1.3), (2.4, 2.3), color=UI['encoder_edge'], lw=1.3)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (5.6, 1.3), (7.2, 2.3), color=UI['encoder_edge'], lw=1.3)

# LLM Backbone (wide, centered)
draw_box(ax_a, (2.0, 4.15), 5.6, 1.05, 'LLM Backbone', sublabel='Llama-2 7B + LoRA',
         fill=UI['llm_fill'], edge=UI['llm_edge'], subfontsize=11)

# Arrows from encoders to LLM (converging)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (2.4, 3.35), (3.6, 4.15), color='#777', lw=1.3)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (7.2, 3.35), (6.0, 4.15), color='#777', lw=1.3)

# Concat annotation
ax_a.text(4.8, 3.75, 'concat (2176-d)', fontsize=10.5, ha='center',
          color=UI['subtle'], style='italic')

# Action Head (left output)
draw_box(ax_a, (1.0, 6.0), 3.2, 1.05, 'Action Head', sublabel='7-DoF tokens',
         fill=UI['action_fill'], edge=UI['action_edge'], subfontsize=11)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (3.3, 5.2), (2.6, 6.0), color=UI['action_edge'], lw=1.6)

# L_action label
ax_a.text(1.1, 7.4, r'$\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{action}}$', fontsize=14,
          ha='center', color=UI['action_edge'], fontweight='bold')
draw_arrow(ax_a, (1.7, 7.3), (2.0, 7.05), color=UI['action_edge'], lw=1.0)

# Aux Head (right output)
draw_box(ax_a, (5.6, 6.0), 3.2, 1.05, 'Aux Head', sublabel='BEV / Depth',
         fill=UI['head_fill'], edge=UI['head_edge'], subfontsize=11)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (6.3, 5.2), (7.2, 6.0), color=UI['head_edge'], lw=1.6)

# lambda * L_aux label
ax_a.text(8.6, 7.4, r'$\lambda(t) \cdot \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{aux}}$',
          fontsize=14, ha='center', color=UI['head_edge'], fontweight='bold')
draw_arrow(ax_a, (8.1, 7.3), (7.8, 7.05), color=UI['head_edge'], lw=1.0)

# BN/LN badge (right of Aux Head)
ax_a.text(9.15, 6.15, 'BN/LN', fontsize=10, ha='center',
          color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], fontweight='bold',
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white',
                    edgecolor=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], lw=1.2))

# Gradient flow dashed arrow (key element — from Aux Head back to LLM)
ax_a.annotate('', xy=(6.8, 3.6), xytext=(7.1, 5.95),
              arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'],
                              lw=2.0, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)),
                              connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.12'))

# "gradient flow?" annotation box (offset right of dashed arrow)
ax_a.text(9.0, 4.55, 'gradient\nflow?', fontsize=11.5, ha='center',
          color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], fontweight='bold', style='italic',
          linespacing=1.2,
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.22', facecolor='#FFF0F0',
                    edgecolor=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], lw=1.0, alpha=0.9))

# "discarded at inference" annotation (above Aux Head)
ax_a.text(7.2, 8.4, 'discarded at inference', fontsize=10.5,
          ha='center', color='#7F8C8D', style='italic',
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#FFF8E1',
                    edgecolor='#BDC3C7', lw=0.8, alpha=0.9))
draw_arrow(ax_a, (7.2, 8.1), (7.2, 7.05), color=UI['subtle'], lw=0.7)


# ============================================================
# PANEL (b): 2x2 Factorial Design
# ============================================================
ax_b.text(0.15, 9.55, '(b)', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])
ax_b.text(0.65, 9.55, 'Factorial Design', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])

mx, my = 1.5, 3.6
mw, mh = 7.2, 4.8
cell_w, cell_h = mw / 2, mh / 2

# Column headers
ax_b.text(mx + cell_w * 0.5, my + mh + 0.55, 'Gradient ON',
          ha='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'])
ax_b.text(mx + cell_w * 1.5, my + mh + 0.55, 'Gradient OFF',
          ha='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['detach_bn'])

# Row headers
ax_b.text(mx - 0.25, my + cell_h * 1.5, 'BN',
          ha='right', va='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=UI['text'])
ax_b.text(mx - 0.25, my + cell_h * 0.5, 'LN',
          ha='right', va='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=UI['text'])

cells_b = [
    (0, 1, 'Full OCC',      'full_occ_bn', '#FDECEA'),
    (1, 1, 'Detach OCC',    'detach_bn',   '#EEEBF5'),
    (0, 0, 'Full OCC+LN',   'full_occ_ln', '#FFF5E0'),
    (1, 0, 'Detach+LN',     'detach_ln',   '#F3EDE6'),
]

# Outer border with shadow
shadow_border = FancyBboxPatch(
    (mx + 0.04, my - 0.04), mw, mh,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.2",
    facecolor='#00000006', edgecolor='none', linewidth=0, zorder=1)
ax_b.add_patch(shadow_border)

border = FancyBboxPatch((mx, my), mw, mh, boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.2",
                         facecolor='white', edgecolor='#BDC3C7', linewidth=1.0, zorder=2)
ax_b.add_patch(border)

# Grid lines
ax_b.plot([mx, mx + mw], [my + cell_h, my + cell_h],
          color=UI['grid'], lw=0.8, zorder=2.5)
ax_b.plot([mx + cell_w, mx + cell_w], [my, my + mh],
          color=UI['grid'], lw=0.8, zorder=2.5)

for col, row, name, ckey, bg in cells_b:
    x = mx + col * cell_w
    y = my + row * cell_h
    pad = 0.12
    inner = FancyBboxPatch((x + pad, y + pad), cell_w - 2*pad, cell_h - 2*pad,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
                           facecolor=bg, edgecolor=COLORS[ckey],
                           linewidth=1.2, zorder=3)
    ax_b.add_patch(inner)
    ax_b.text(x + cell_w/2, y + cell_h/2, name,
              ha='center', va='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
              color=COLORS[ckey], zorder=4)

# Additional conditions
ax_b.text(mx, my - 0.55, 'Additional:', fontsize=11.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=UI['text'])
extras = [
    ('Random OCC',      COLORS['random_occ']),
    ('Depth-only',      COLORS['depth']),
    ('Cutoff / Reverse', COLORS['cutoff']),
    ('Vanilla (no aux)', COLORS['vanilla']),
]
for i, (name, color) in enumerate(extras):
    cx = mx if i < 2 else mx + 3.8
    cy = my - 1.05 - (i % 2) * 0.50
    ax_b.plot(cx + 0.1, cy, 's', color=color, markersize=5, zorder=4)
    ax_b.text(cx + 0.4, cy, name, fontsize=10.5, va='center', color=UI['text'])

# Factor summary
ax_b.text(mx + mw/2, my - 2.7,
          '5 factors across 12 conditions:\ngradient flow / label content / normalization\n'
          'reference frame / temporal extent',
          ha='center', fontsize=10, color=UI['subtle'], style='italic',
          linespacing=1.3)

# Save
out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513/projects/occsafe_vla/docs/paper/figures'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig1_architecture_pb.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight',
            pad_inches=0.05, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
print("Saved fig1_architecture_pb.png")

"""
fig1_architecture_pb.py — Hero figure panels (a) + (b) for CoRL 2026.
Two-panel overview: (a) Training setup, (b) Factorial design.
Fallback matplotlib version (PaperBanana API unavailable).
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, BoxStyle
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

COLORS = {
    'vanilla':     '#4C72B0',
    'full_occ_bn': '#C44E52',
    'full_occ_ln': '#E69F00',
    'random_occ':  '#55A868',
    'detach_bn':   '#8172B3',
    'detach_ln':   '#937860',
    'depth':       '#CCB974',
    'cutoff':      '#64B5CD',
}

UI = {
    'text':         '#2C3E50',
    'subtle':       '#95A5A6',
    'encoder_fill': '#EBF0F7',
    'encoder_edge': '#4C72B0',
    'llm_fill':     '#F5F0E8',
    'llm_edge':     '#937860',
    'head_fill':    '#FFF3E0',
    'head_edge':    '#E69F00',
    'action_fill':  '#E8F5E9',
    'action_edge':  '#55A868',
    'grid':         '#DEE2E6',
    'bg_light':     '#F8F9FA',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Liberation Serif', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 14,
    'text.color': UI['text'],
    'axes.labelcolor': UI['text'],
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'cm',
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5.5), dpi=300, facecolor='white')

ax_a = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.04, 0.50, 0.90])
ax_b = fig.add_axes([0.535, 0.04, 0.45, 0.90])

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.axis('off')


def draw_box(ax, xy, w, h, label, sublabel=None, fill='white', edge='#333',
             fontsize=13, subfontsize=11, lw=1.6, radius=0.20, shadow=True,
             label_color=None):
    if shadow:
        shadow_box = FancyBboxPatch(
            (xy[0] + 0.04, xy[1] - 0.04), w, h,
            boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
            facecolor='#00000008', edgecolor='none', linewidth=0, zorder=2)
        ax.add_patch(shadow_box)
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    cx, cy = xy[0] + w/2, xy[1] + h/2
    tc = label_color if label_color else UI['text']
    if sublabel:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.22, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight='bold', color=tc, zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.26, sublabel, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=subfontsize,
                color=UI['subtle'], zorder=4, style='italic')
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fontsize,
                fontweight='bold', color=tc, zorder=4)


def draw_arrow(ax, start, end, color='#555', lw=1.4, style='->', mutation=12):
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(start, end, arrowstyle=style, color=color,
                            linewidth=lw, mutation_scale=mutation, zorder=2,
                            shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)


# ============================================================
# PANEL (a): Training Architecture
# ============================================================
ax_a.text(0.15, 9.55, '(a)', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])
ax_a.text(0.65, 9.55, 'Training Setup', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])

# --- Architecture centered around x=5 ---
# RGB Observation (centered)
draw_box(ax_a, (3.0, 0.3), 3.6, 1.0, 'RGB Observation', fill='#F0F4F8',
         edge=UI['subtle'], fontsize=11.5, lw=1.2)

# Encoders (symmetric about center)
draw_box(ax_a, (0.8, 2.3), 3.2, 1.05, 'DINOv2', sublabel='1024-d patches',
         fill=UI['encoder_fill'], edge=UI['encoder_edge'], subfontsize=11)
draw_box(ax_a, (5.6, 2.3), 3.2, 1.05, 'SigLIP', sublabel='1152-d patches',
         fill=UI['encoder_fill'], edge=UI['encoder_edge'], subfontsize=11)

# Arrows from RGB to encoders
draw_arrow(ax_a, (4.0, 1.3), (2.4, 2.3), color=UI['encoder_edge'], lw=1.3)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (5.6, 1.3), (7.2, 2.3), color=UI['encoder_edge'], lw=1.3)

# LLM Backbone (wide, centered)
draw_box(ax_a, (2.0, 4.15), 5.6, 1.05, 'LLM Backbone', sublabel='Llama-2 7B + LoRA',
         fill=UI['llm_fill'], edge=UI['llm_edge'], subfontsize=11)

# Arrows from encoders to LLM (converging)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (2.4, 3.35), (3.6, 4.15), color='#777', lw=1.3)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (7.2, 3.35), (6.0, 4.15), color='#777', lw=1.3)

# Concat annotation
ax_a.text(4.8, 3.75, 'concat (2176-d)', fontsize=10.5, ha='center',
          color=UI['subtle'], style='italic')

# Action Head (left output)
draw_box(ax_a, (1.0, 6.0), 3.2, 1.05, 'Action Head', sublabel='7-DoF tokens',
         fill=UI['action_fill'], edge=UI['action_edge'], subfontsize=11)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (3.3, 5.2), (2.6, 6.0), color=UI['action_edge'], lw=1.6)

# L_action label
ax_a.text(1.1, 7.4, r'$\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{action}}$', fontsize=14,
          ha='center', color=UI['action_edge'], fontweight='bold')
draw_arrow(ax_a, (1.7, 7.3), (2.0, 7.05), color=UI['action_edge'], lw=1.0)

# Aux Head (right output)
draw_box(ax_a, (5.6, 6.0), 3.2, 1.05, 'Aux Head', sublabel='BEV / Depth',
         fill=UI['head_fill'], edge=UI['head_edge'], subfontsize=11)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (6.3, 5.2), (7.2, 6.0), color=UI['head_edge'], lw=1.6)

# lambda * L_aux label
ax_a.text(8.6, 7.4, r'$\lambda(t) \cdot \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{aux}}$',
          fontsize=14, ha='center', color=UI['head_edge'], fontweight='bold')
draw_arrow(ax_a, (8.1, 7.3), (7.8, 7.05), color=UI['head_edge'], lw=1.0)

# BN/LN badge (right of Aux Head)
ax_a.text(9.15, 6.15, 'BN/LN', fontsize=10, ha='center',
          color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], fontweight='bold',
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white',
                    edgecolor=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], lw=1.2))

# Gradient flow dashed arrow (key element — from Aux Head back to LLM)
ax_a.annotate('', xy=(6.8, 3.6), xytext=(7.1, 5.95),
              arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'],
                              lw=2.0, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)),
                              connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.12'))

# "gradient flow?" annotation box (offset right of dashed arrow)
ax_a.text(9.0, 4.55, 'gradient\nflow?', fontsize=11.5, ha='center',
          color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], fontweight='bold', style='italic',
          linespacing=1.2,
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.22', facecolor='#FFF0F0',
                    edgecolor=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], lw=1.0, alpha=0.9))

# "discarded at inference" annotation (above Aux Head)
ax_a.text(7.2, 8.4, 'discarded at inference', fontsize=10.5,
          ha='center', color='#7F8C8D', style='italic',
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#FFF8E1',
                    edgecolor='#BDC3C7', lw=0.8, alpha=0.9))
draw_arrow(ax_a, (7.2, 8.1), (7.2, 7.05), color=UI['subtle'], lw=0.7)


# ============================================================
# PANEL (b): 2x2 Factorial Design
# ============================================================
ax_b.text(0.15, 9.55, '(b)', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])
ax_b.text(0.65, 9.55, 'Factorial Design', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])

mx, my = 1.5, 3.6
mw, mh = 7.2, 4.8
cell_w, cell_h = mw / 2, mh / 2

# Column headers
ax_b.text(mx + cell_w * 0.5, my + mh + 0.55, 'Gradient ON',
          ha='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'])
ax_b.text(mx + cell_w * 1.5, my + mh + 0.55, 'Gradient OFF',
          ha='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['detach_bn'])

# Row headers
ax_b.text(mx - 0.25, my + cell_h * 1.5, 'BN',
          ha='right', va='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=UI['text'])
ax_b.text(mx - 0.25, my + cell_h * 0.5, 'LN',
          ha='right', va='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=UI['text'])

cells_b = [
    (0, 1, 'Full OCC',      'full_occ_bn', '#FDECEA'),
    (1, 1, 'Detach OCC',    'detach_bn',   '#EEEBF5'),
    (0, 0, 'Full OCC+LN',   'full_occ_ln', '#FFF5E0'),
    (1, 0, 'Detach+LN',     'detach_ln',   '#F3EDE6'),
]

# Outer border with shadow
shadow_border = FancyBboxPatch(
    (mx + 0.04, my - 0.04), mw, mh,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.2",
    facecolor='#00000006', edgecolor='none', linewidth=0, zorder=1)
ax_b.add_patch(shadow_border)

border = FancyBboxPatch((mx, my), mw, mh, boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.2",
                         facecolor='white', edgecolor='#BDC3C7', linewidth=1.0, zorder=2)
ax_b.add_patch(border)

# Grid lines
ax_b.plot([mx, mx + mw], [my + cell_h, my + cell_h],
          color=UI['grid'], lw=0.8, zorder=2.5)
ax_b.plot([mx + cell_w, mx + cell_w], [my, my + mh],
          color=UI['grid'], lw=0.8, zorder=2.5)

for col, row, name, ckey, bg in cells_b:
    x = mx + col * cell_w
    y = my + row * cell_h
    pad = 0.12
    inner = FancyBboxPatch((x + pad, y + pad), cell_w - 2*pad, cell_h - 2*pad,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
                           facecolor=bg, edgecolor=COLORS[ckey],
                           linewidth=1.2, zorder=3)
    ax_b.add_patch(inner)
    ax_b.text(x + cell_w/2, y + cell_h/2, name,
              ha='center', va='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
              color=COLORS[ckey], zorder=4)

# Additional conditions
ax_b.text(mx, my - 0.65, 'Additional:', fontsize=11.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=UI['text'])
extras = [
    ('Random OCC',      COLORS['random_occ']),
    ('Depth-only',      COLORS['depth']),
    ('Cutoff / Reverse', COLORS['cutoff']),
    ('Vanilla (no aux)', COLORS['vanilla']),
]
for i, (name, color) in enumerate(extras):
    cx = mx if i < 2 else mx + 3.8
    cy = my - 1.15 - (i % 2) * 0.50
    ax_b.plot(cx + 0.1, cy, 's', color=color, markersize=5, zorder=4)
    ax_b.text(cx + 0.4, cy, name, fontsize=10.5, va='center', color=UI['text'])

# Factor summary
ax_b.text(mx + mw/2, my - 2.85,
          '5 factors across 12 conditions:\ngradient flow / label content / normalization\n'
          'reference frame / temporal extent',
          ha='center', fontsize=10, color=UI['subtle'], style='italic',
          linespacing=1.3)

# Save
out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513/projects/occsafe_vla/docs/paper/figures'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig1_architecture_pb.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight',

print("Saved fig1_architecture_pb.png")

draw_box(ax_a, (2.0, 4.15), 5.6, 1.05, 'LLM Backbone', sublabel='Llama-2 7B + LoRA',
         fill=UI['llm_fill'], edge=UI['llm_edge'], subfontsize=11)

# Arrows from encoders to LLM (converging)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (2.4, 3.35), (3.6, 4.15), color='#777', lw=1.3)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (7.2, 3.35), (6.0, 4.15), color='#777', lw=1.3)

# Concat annotation
ax_a.text(4.8, 3.75, 'concat (2176-d)', fontsize=10.5, ha='center',
          color=UI['subtle'], style='italic')

# Action Head (left output)
draw_box(ax_a, (1.0, 6.0), 3.2, 1.05, 'Action Head', sublabel='7-DoF tokens',
         fill=UI['action_fill'], edge=UI['action_edge'], subfontsize=11)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (3.3, 5.2), (2.6, 6.0), color=UI['action_edge'], lw=1.6)

# L_action label
ax_a.text(1.1, 7.4, r'$\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{action}}$', fontsize=14,
          ha='center', color=UI['action_edge'], fontweight='bold')
draw_arrow(ax_a, (1.7, 7.3), (2.0, 7.05), color=UI['action_edge'], lw=1.0)

# Aux Head (right output)
draw_box(ax_a, (5.6, 6.0), 3.2, 1.05, 'Aux Head', sublabel='BEV / Depth',
         fill=UI['head_fill'], edge=UI['head_edge'], subfontsize=11)
draw_arrow(ax_a, (6.3, 5.2), (7.2, 6.0), color=UI['head_edge'], lw=1.6)

# lambda * L_aux label
ax_a.text(8.6, 7.4, r'$\lambda(t) \cdot \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{aux}}$',
          fontsize=14, ha='center', color=UI['head_edge'], fontweight='bold')
draw_arrow(ax_a, (8.1, 7.3), (7.8, 7.05), color=UI['head_edge'], lw=1.0)

# BN/LN badge (right of Aux Head)
ax_a.text(9.15, 6.15, 'BN/LN', fontsize=10, ha='center',
          color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], fontweight='bold',
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white',
                    edgecolor=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], lw=1.2))

# Gradient flow dashed arrow (key element — from Aux Head back to LLM)
ax_a.annotate('', xy=(6.8, 3.6), xytext=(7.1, 5.95),
              arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->,head_length=0.4,head_width=0.25',
                              color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'],
                              lw=2.2, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)),
                              connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.12'))

# "gradient flow?" annotation box (offset right of dashed arrow)
ax_a.text(9.0, 4.55, 'gradient\nflow?', fontsize=11.5, ha='center',
          color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], fontweight='bold', style='italic',
          linespacing=1.2,
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.22', facecolor='#FFF0F0',
                    edgecolor=COLORS['full_occ_bn'], lw=1.0, alpha=0.9))

# "discarded at inference" annotation (above Aux Head)
ax_a.text(7.2, 8.4, 'discarded at inference', fontsize=10.5,
          ha='center', color='#7F8C8D', style='italic',
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#FFF8E1',
                    edgecolor='#BDC3C7', lw=0.8, alpha=0.9))
draw_arrow(ax_a, (7.2, 8.1), (7.2, 7.05), color=UI['subtle'], lw=0.7)


# --- Subtle panel divider ---
divider_x = 0.52
fig.add_artist(plt.Line2D([divider_x, divider_x], [0.08, 0.88],
               transform=fig.transFigure, color='#E0E0E0', lw=0.6, zorder=0))

# ============================================================
# PANEL (b): 2x2 Factorial Design
# ============================================================
ax_b.text(0.15, 9.55, '(b)', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])
ax_b.text(0.65, 9.55, 'Factorial Design', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='top', color=UI['text'])

mx, my = 1.5, 3.6
mw, mh = 7.2, 4.8
cell_w, cell_h = mw / 2, mh / 2

# Column headers
ax_b.text(mx + cell_w * 0.5, my + mh + 0.55, 'Gradient ON',
          ha='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['full_occ_bn'])
ax_b.text(mx + cell_w * 1.5, my + mh + 0.55, 'Gradient OFF',
          ha='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['detach_bn'])

# Row headers
ax_b.text(mx - 0.25, my + cell_h * 1.5, 'BN',
          ha='right', va='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=UI['text'])
ax_b.text(mx - 0.25, my + cell_h * 0.5, 'LN',
          ha='right', va='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=UI['text'])

cells_b = [
    (0, 1, 'Full OCC',      'full_occ_bn', '#FDECEA'),
    (1, 1, 'Detach OCC',    'detach_bn',   '#EEEBF5'),
    (0, 0, 'Full OCC+LN',   'full_occ_ln', '#FFF5E0'),
    (1, 0, 'Detach+LN',     'detach_ln',   '#F3EDE6'),
]

# Outer border with shadow
shadow_border = FancyBboxPatch(
    (mx + 0.04, my - 0.04), mw, mh,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.2",
    facecolor='#00000006', edgecolor='none', linewidth=0, zorder=1)
ax_b.add_patch(shadow_border)

border = FancyBboxPatch((mx, my), mw, mh, boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.2",
                         facecolor='white', edgecolor='#BDC3C7', linewidth=1.0, zorder=2)
ax_b.add_patch(border)

# Grid lines
ax_b.plot([mx, mx + mw], [my + cell_h, my + cell_h],
          color=UI['grid'], lw=0.8, zorder=2.5)
ax_b.plot([mx + cell_w, mx + cell_w], [my, my + mh],
          color=UI['grid'], lw=0.8, zorder=2.5)

for col, row, name, ckey, bg in cells_b:
    x = mx + col * cell_w
    y = my + row * cell_h
    pad = 0.12
    inner = FancyBboxPatch((x + pad, y + pad), cell_w - 2*pad, cell_h - 2*pad,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.15",
                           facecolor=bg, edgecolor=COLORS[ckey],
                           linewidth=1.2, zorder=3)
    ax_b.add_patch(inner)
    ax_b.text(x + cell_w/2, y + cell_h/2, name,
              ha='center', va='center', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
              color=COLORS[ckey], zorder=4)

# Additional conditions
ax_b.text(mx, my - 0.65, 'Additional:', fontsize=11.5,
          fontweight='bold', color=UI['text'])
extras = [
    ('Random OCC',      COLORS['random_occ']),
    ('Depth-only',      COLORS['depth']),
    ('Cutoff / Reverse', COLORS['cutoff']),
    ('Vanilla (no aux)', COLORS['vanilla']),
]
for i, (name, color) in enumerate(extras):
    cx = mx if i < 2 else mx + 3.8
    cy = my - 1.15 - (i % 2) * 0.50
    ax_b.plot(cx + 0.1, cy, 's', color=color, markersize=5, zorder=4)
    ax_b.text(cx + 0.4, cy, name, fontsize=10.5, va='center', color=UI['text'])

# Factor summary
ax_b.text(mx + mw/2, my - 2.85,
          '5 factors across 12 conditions:\ngradient flow / label content / normalization\n'
          'reference frame / temporal extent',
          ha='center', fontsize=10, color=UI['subtle'], style='italic',
          linespacing=1.3)

# Save
out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513/projects/occsafe_vla/docs/paper/figures'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig1_architecture_pb.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight',
